brief:
Media outlets have whitewashed Israeli military operations in Lebanon by obscuring their legal status, according to commentary citing what it characterizes as systematic violations. The analysis points to near-daily Israeli attacks continuing since a ceasefire in November 2024, arguing these actions parallel conduct in Gaza that international observers have documented as potential war crimes.

A CNN headline describing Hezbollah as restarting conflict despite ongoing Israeli military operations exemplifies how coverage frames Palestinian and Lebanese armed groups as aggressors while omitting Israeli actions from conflict narratives, the commentary contends. The framing sidesteps questions about whether Israeli conduct meets the threshold of war crimes under international humanitarian law.

title: Israeli attacks on Lebanon constitute war crimes, analysis claims
